mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (menu_item_id, user_id, rating, comment) VALUES (#{menuItemId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.menu_item_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.comment, r.created_at, u.username AS username FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.menu_item_id = #{menuItemId} ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.menu_item_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.comment, r.created_at, u.username AS username, m.name AS item_name FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN menu_items m ON r.menu_item_id = m.id WHERE m.stall_id = #{stallId} ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.menu_item_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.comment, r.created_at, u.username AS username, m.name AS item_name FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN menu_items m ON r.menu_item_id = m.id ORDER BY r.id DESC
SELECT id, menu_item_id, user_id, rating, comment, created_at FROM reviews WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND menu_item_id = #{menuItemId} LIMIT 1
